content.short: InstaDApp gives DeFi users an easy way to access the best DeFi strategies.
content.description: InstaDApp offers a feature-rich DeFi platform designed for both everyday users and developers who want to unlock DeFi's full potential. The InstaDApp protocol (DSL) acts as middleware, aggregating multiple DeFi protocols into a single, upgradable smart contract layer. This unified architecture provides a consistent on-chain interface, simplifying integration, experimentation, and upgrades as the DeFi landscape evolves. By consolidating diverse protocols, InstaDApp enables easier access to a broad set of DeFi tools within one programmable foundation.
content.meta: InstaDApp is a DeFi platform that aggregates protocols into an upgradable layer. Discover InstaDApp and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
